theorems.name: Submission.dorag_aa_finite_separated_net
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (K A : Set (Euclid P)) (s : ℝ) (a : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < s → 0 < a → μ A ≠ ∞ → (∀ y ∈ K, closedBall y (s / 2) ⊆ A) → (∀ y ∈ K, a ≤ μ (closedBall y (s / 2))) → ∃ F : Finset (Euclid P), (↑F : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ K ∧ (F.card : ℝ≥0∞) * a ≤ μ A ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∃ y ∈ F, dist x y ≤ s
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
